description: This file contains SCSS mixins related to hover states, specifically designed for handling hover styles and compatibility issues on touch devices like iOS. It defines several mixins such as 'hover', 'hover-focus', and others to facilitate hover styling in CSS using Sass.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: A Sass mixin that applies hover styles within an element, used to attach hover content.

methods.name: hover-focus
methods.description: A Sass mixin that applies styles on hover or focus states.

methods.name: plain-hover-focus
methods.description: A Sass mixin that applies styles to the base state, hover, and focus states.

methods.name: hover-focus-active
methods.description: A Sass mixin that applies styles on hover, focus, and active states.
